metadata.agent_last_message:
The implementation is complete. Summary:

**Project structure:**
- `output/Cargo.toml` — package manifest with empty `[dependencies]`
- `output/src/main.rs` — CLI entrypoint
- `output/src/{bib,bst,interp,json,name,output,warning,width}.rs` — modules

**What it does:**
- Parses `.bib` databases (regular entries, `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`; both `{}` and `()` delimiters; numbers, braced/quoted strings, macro refs, `#` concatenation; 12 predefined month macros; crossref inheritance with cycle detection).
- Parses `.bst` style files (10 top-level commands; identifiers, integer literals, string literals, function literals, quoted function refs; `%` comments).
- Implements all 37 built-in functions including `format.name$` (4-part Form 1/2/3 name parsing), `change.case$` with title-mode rules, `purify$` with special-character handling, `width$` using the cmr10 character-width table from `bibtex.web` §13, `text.length$` / `text.prefix$` with brace-protected counting.
- Stack-based interpreter with field-access in iterate/reverse contexts, stable sort by `sort.key$`, runtime warnings with default-value substitution.
- Output buffer with bibtex-style 79-column line wrapping (backward scan to col 3, forward-scan fallback) and 2-space continuation indent.
- CLI: `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux` (extracts `\citation{...}`), `--output`, `--log`. Cites and aux concatenated (cites first) with case-insensitive dedup.
- Structured JSON log (entries_read, entries_cited_found/missing, functions_defined, macros_defined including months, iterations, sorts, reverse_iterations, execute_calls, warnings).
- Error JSON written to `--output` on exit-1 failures (parse errors, missing files, undefined functions); exit 2 for unexpected internal panics.
- Seven warning kinds (`unresolved_crossref`, `crossref_cycle`, `unresolved_macro`, `duplicate_key`, `bst_type_error`, `bst_undefined_field`, `bst_undefined_function`) preserving chronological order.

Verified against all four canoni
